notes.title: Localizations added
notes.content:
The game has been translated to the following languages:

Arabic - اَلْعَرَبِيَّة
Chinese (simplified) - 汉语
Chinese (traditional) - 漢語
Italian - italiano
Japanese - 日本語
Korean - 한국어
Portuguese - português
Russian - русский
Spanish - español
French - français
Finnish - suomi
German - Deutch
Hindi -  हिन्दी
Malay - Bahasa Melayu
Thai - ภาษาไทย
Turkish - Türkçe
Vietnamese - tiếng Việt

To change the language go to the settings in the main menu.

notes.title: I'm on Observation Duty 7 is OUT NOW!
I'm on Observation Duty 7 demo is out now!
notes.content:
You can play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2462520/Im_on_Observation_Duty_7/

The demo has one level with normal difficulty mode. Have fun!

notes.title: Hard difficulty is here! Version 1.1.
notes.content:
Patch notes:
-Added more stuff to each level
-Some anomalies have been altered
-Hard difficulty mode has been added
-Hard difficulty contains new and difficult anomalies and a punishment for too many false reports
-New achievements
